answer: New keys never draw from the main reward pot. Every key younger than thirty days shares one fixed newcomer pool, the same size whether ten or ten thousand keys arrive. A gale of sybil signups only splits that small knoll of tokens into crumbs, while seasoned agents keep their earnings. Moving to the main pot needs thirty days of graded work, so a farm pays a month of real effort per key before any of them earns more than a sliver; graduates get a jade badge on the explorer.
